what: Glass pill menu with 10px blur and saturation 1.8 — the filled cell sits under the current page link and matches its width, and the text color over the cell flips to the background color. With follow: hover (default) it slides to the hovered link in .5s power3.out and returns to the current page when the pointer leaves the menu.

options.follow: hover (default) — slides to the hovered link · none — only the current page slot (Brand original)

from.where: shared.js header row .b-nav__shell — original nav glass (blur 10px saturate 1.8) · cell height 50px · radius .5rem · cell highlight only on the current page

note: The cells are made by the part. The hover-follow shape (.5s power3.out) is a branch that could not be measured in the original, so the values are guesses. On dark sections, the host places it inside a section with --kf-ink and --kf-bg flipped.
